thread:
Ava (Product): Quick thread about Playground chat UX. Main asks: streaming rendering, Stop/Regenerate affordance, token counter visibility, and making the prompt library discoverable without interrupting flow. Thoughts? Marco (Design): Mock attached. My initial nits: the shimmer on streaming is noisy and conflicts with inline links. Propose switching to a low-contrast animated ellipsis and fade-in for completed text. Jin (Frontend): Implementation reality check: we get partial deltas over WS. We should avoid reflow when we append mid-sentence. Plan: render into an offscreen container and swap in at line breaks or after a small debounce (50-100ms). Riley (Eng): A11y checklist item: screen readers need a single concise announce like "Answer is streaming" when it starts and "Answer complete" when done. Add aria-live=polite for the container and update aria-atomic behavior. Marco (Design): Stop / Regenerate toolbar idea: contextual small toolbar on message hover. When streaming: show a primary Stop button + a muted Copy icon. After finish: show Retry (icon + label) and Copy. Keep buttons reachable by keyboard. Olivia (PM): Regarding token counter: novices hate numbers. Suggest collapsed token indicator by default with "~150" visible; click expands to show prompt vs response tokens and cost estimate. Persist preference in local settings. Jin (Frontend): We can receive an approx_tokens field from server per-stream chunk to update counter progressively. Cheaper on client and avoids rerunning tokenizer. We'll spec event names: playground.token.update and playground.stream.start/stop. Ava (Product): UX copy question: "Retry" vs "Regenerate". Which is clearer? Also think about keyboard affordances (Esc to Stop, Alt+R to retry?) Marco (Design): I prefer "Regenerate" for power users, but "Retry" is shorter and more approachable. Maybe show full word on hover. For keyboard, Esc to Stop is standard; use Ctrl/⌘+Enter to regenerate. Show tooltip with shortcut. Riley (Eng): Perf note: token counter updates every chunk could be noisy. Throttle to 200ms and ensure we don't block render. Also add telemetry to measure how often users stop mid-stream vs let complete. Jin (Frontend): Keyboard nav: when streaming starts, focus should move to Stop button so keyboard users can press Enter immediately. But this must be announced to SR: "Focus moved to Stop generation". Marco (Design): Prompt library discovery: show a subtle inline chip inside the composer saying "Try prompts" when composer is empty. If clicked, show a lightweight drawer (not full modal) with categories. A/B test drawer vs sidebar. Olivia (PM): A/B ideas: chip vs persistent left rail promo. Metrics: conversion to selected prompt, time-to-first-response. I'll write the brief. Riley (Eng): Accessibility color check: the current orange token pill fails contrast in dark mode. Use WCAG tools and propose a darker hue or outline. Jin (Frontend): Sample aria snippet for streaming area:
Streaming started
We should debounce announcements to avoid repeated SR spam. Marco (Design): One more micro-copy: ephemeral state label while streaming: "generating..." (lowercase) looks friendlier than "Generating". Small detail but consistent across product. Ava (Product): Great. Owners: Marco -> revised mocks (ellipses, toolbar), Jin -> prototype for offscreen render + token update events, Riley -> a11y checklist + contrasts, Olivia -> A/B test plan. Please drop links and PRs here. deploy-bot: Visual diff: https://redwood.design/diffs/playground/ui-iter-4 Jin (Frontend): One quick Q: should transcript save partial responses if user stops? I think yes, but mark as incomplete. UX to show an "Incomplete" badge. Marco (Design): Good call. Add a small orange "incomplete" badge on the message when stopped mid-stream. Riley (Eng): I'll add tickets: PLAY-482 a11y streaming, PLAY-483 toolbar, PLAY-484 token counter preference, PLAY-485 prompt-discovery A/B. Ava (Product): Thanks everyone — feel free to ping if blockers. :sparkles:
